propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui beatum Franciscum, novi Ordinis institutorem, orandi studio et
paenitentiae amore decorasti: da famulis tuis in ejus imitatione ita
proficere; ut, semper orantes et corpus in servitutem redigentes, ad
caelestem gloriam pervenire mereantur. Per Dominum nostrum.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

translations.text: O God, Who didst adorn blessed Francis, as the founder of a new order, with the spirit of prayer and the love of penance, grant Thy servants to make such progress in imitating him that, by prayer without ceasing, and by bringing the body into subjection, they may deserve to attain heavenly glory. Through our Lord.
